top_band: light/mid green upper leaf crown and top of foliage clumps (rows 1-28)
evidence: Volumetric foliage clumps with lighter top surfaces (e.g. rows 1-10 on top lobe, 22-28 on central lobe) and darker undersides overhanging the trunk (rows 48-78).

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul tree references, the candidate uses very dark/near-black outlines around both the foliage clumps and the straight geometric trunk. The trunk is a stiff vertical column with a flat horizontal base line (row 78) instead of organic roots, and the canopy is composed of repetitive spherical broccoli-like puffs rather than individual leaf clusters.
